summary: Comprehensive, exhaustive architectural implementation plan for Tiba Perfumes & Royal Oud (طيبة للعطور والعود الملكي). Covers complete end-to-end development of all 12 platform views: Customer Storefront, Alchemist Scent Advisor Quiz, 96% Match Result Showcase, Royal Vault Catalog, Velvet Discovery Kit Customizer, 3D Product Detail Page, Anti-RTO Checkout, Admin Operations Dashboard, Inventory & Pricing Controller, Shipping Orders & 4x6 Thermal Waybill Generator, Commercial Promotions Engine, and Scent Taste Analytics BI. Implements Tajawal & Noto Kufi typography, 3D bottle physics, canvas incense mist, fluid crucible simulation, and unified reactive state synchronization.
